dict.string: GBV Shield needs access to your location to send your position during SOS emergencies.
GBV Shield requires location access even when the app is closed to share your position in emergencies.
GBV Shield requires continuous location access to send your SOS location when triggered by shaking.
The app may use the camera for user reports or profile setup.
GBV Shield may access your photos for uploading evidence or setting profile pictures.
GBV Shield uses notifications to alert you and your contacts in case of emergencies.
GBV Shield may use Bluetooth to detect nearby safety devices.
Motion data is used to detect shake gestures for SOS activation.
Microphone access is needed if you record voice reports or evidence.
